value.rationale: The 2022 source explicitly motivates the easily computed mean-degree tuning of random-forest inverse-trace controls. The unit-weight star is a canonical maximally degree-heterogeneous family. The full finite-size formula and integer-sequence limit show that mean-degree tuning can lose all asymptotic variance reduction while the optimum gives a factor-two improvement. This is a meaningful quantitative boundary for a naturally prescribed tuning method, not a random parameter slice; limitations exclude broader graph claims and equal-runtime comparisons.
